cases.name: Sally Geiger Brainerd
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Sally was a graduate of Clemson University and enjoyed a long career as a registered nurse, retiring from Greenville Memorial Hospital. Her hobbies included embroidery, painting, and gardening. She had a kind, generous spirit and loved animals and caring for others. Her children and grandchildren were the most important people in her life, and she treasured every moment spent with them. Her family loved her beyond measure and will miss her immensely."
